title.en: Build a Longest Word Finder App
title.fr: Crée une application de recherche du mot le plus long

description.en: In this lab, you will build a function that returns the length of the longest word in the provided sentence.
description.fr: Dans ce lab, tu vas créer une fonction qui retourne la longueur du mot le plus long dans la phrase fournie.

description.en: For example, in the sentence `"The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy dog"`, the longest word is `"jumped"`, which has a length of 6.
description.fr: Par exemple, dans la phrase `"The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy dog"`, le mot le plus long est `"jumped"`, qui a une longueur de 6.

description.en: **Objective:** Fulfill the user stories below and get all the tests to pass to complete the lab.
description.fr: **Objectif :** réalise les user stories ci-dessous et fais passer tous les tests pour terminer le lab.

description.en:
1. You should create a function named `findLongestWordLength` that takes a string as an argument.
2. The function should return the length of the longest word in the string.
description.fr:
1. Tu dois créer une fonction nommée `findLongestWordLength` qui prend une chaîne en argument.
2. La fonction doit retourner la longueur du mot le plus long de la chaîne.

hints.en: You should create a function named `findLongestWordLength`.
hints.fr: Tu dois créer une fonction nommée `findLongestWordLength`.

hints.en: `findLongestWordLength("The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy dog")` should return a number.
hints.fr: `findLongestWordLength("The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy dog")` doit retourner un nombre.

hints.en: `findLongestWordLength("The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy dog")` should return `6`.
hints.fr: `findLongestWordLength("The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy dog")` doit retourner `6`.

hints.en: `findLongestWordLength("May the force be with you")` should return `5`.
hints.fr: `findLongestWordLength("May the force be with you")` doit retourner `5`.

hints.en: `findLongestWordLength("Google do a barrel roll")` should return `6`.
hints.fr: `findLongestWordLength("Google do a barrel roll")` doit retourner `6`.

hints.en: `findLongestWordLength("Googling do a barrel roll")` should return `8`.
hints.fr: `findLongestWordLength("Googling do a barrel roll")` doit retourner `8`.

hints.en: `findLongestWordLength("What is the average airspeed velocity of an unladen swallow")` should return `8`.
hints.fr: `findLongestWordLength("What is the average airspeed velocity of an unladen swallow")` doit retourner `8`.

hints.en: `findLongestWordLength("What if we try a super-long word such as otorhinolaryngology")` should return `19`.
hints.fr: `findLongestWordLength("What if we try a super-long word such as otorhinolaryngology")` doit retourner `19`.
